description: This is a Java test source file that contains unit tests for the MqttContext class within the org.eclipse.hono.adapter.mqtt package. It verifies various behaviors such as tenant extraction, property bag retrieval from MQTT topics, and endpoint expansion logic.

classes.name: MqttContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MqttContext, validating its behavior in extracting tenant info, property bag data, and endpoint expansion.

methods.name: testTenantIsRetrievedFromAuthenticatedDevice
methods.description: Tests that the tenant is correctly extracted from an authenticated Device object.

methods.name: testTenantIsRetrievedFromTopic
methods.description: Tests that the tenant is correctly retrieved from the MQTT topic when device authentication info is absent.

methods.name: verifyPropertyBagRetrievedFromTopic
methods.description: Verifies that the property bag correctly parses parameters from the topic string.

methods.name: testFactoryMethodExpandsShortNames
methods.description: Tests that the factory method properly expands endpoint short names to full types.

methods.name: assertEndpoint
methods.description: Helper to assert that a message's endpoint type matches the expected type.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a mock MQTT publish message with a specific topic structure.
